import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static final int MAX_M = 2000015;
    static final int MAX_N = 5775;
    
    static int n, m, c, d, k;
    
    static class Edge {
        int dest, next_edge, capacity, flow, weight;
        Edge(int dest, int next_edge, int capacity, int flow, int weight) {
            this.dest = dest;
            this.next_edge = next_edge;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.weight = weight;
        }
    }
    
    static Edge[] graph = new Edge[MAX_M];
    static int[] adj = new int[MAX_N];
    static int edge_count;
    static int[] prev_edge = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] dist = new int[MAX_N];
    static boolean[] in_queue = new boolean[MAX_N];
    static int node_count;
    
    static int input() throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        int c;
        while ((c = br.read()) != -1 && (c < '0' || c > '9')) {
            if (c == '-') {
                // Handle negative sign
                sb.append((char)c);
            }
        }
        if (c == -1) return 0;
        while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            sb.append((char)c);
            c = br.read();
            if (c == -1) break;
        }
        String numStr = sb.toString();
        if (numStr.isEmpty()) return 0;
        if (numStr.equals("-")) return 0;
        return Integer.parseInt(numStr);
    }
    
    static void reset(int total_nodes) {
        node_count = total_nodes;
        edge_count = 0;
        Arrays.fill(adj, -1);
    }
    
    static void connect(int from, int to, int cap, int cost) {
        graph[edge_count] = new Edge(to, adj[from], cap, 0, cost);
        adj[from] = edge_count++;
        graph[edge_count] = new Edge(from, adj[to], 0, 0, -cost);
        adj[to] = edge_count++;
    }
    
    static boolean find_path(int source, int sink) {
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
        Arrays.fill(in_queue, false);
        Arrays.fill(prev_edge, -1);
        dist[source] = 0;
        in_queue[source] = true;
        q.offer(source);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            in_queue[u] = false;
            for (int i = adj[u]; ~i != 0; i = graph[i].next_edge) {
                int v = graph[i].dest;
                if (graph[i].capacity > graph[i].flow && dist[v] > dist[u] + graph[i].weight) {
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + graph[i].weight;
                    prev_edge[v] = i;
                    if (!in_queue[v]) {
                        in_queue[v] = true;
                        q.offer(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return prev_edge[sink] != -1;
    }
    
    static int compute_min_cost_flow(int src, int dst, int[] total_cost) {
        int total_flow = 0;
        total_cost[0] = 0;
        while (find_path(src, dst)) {
            int bottleneck = INF;
            for (int i = prev_edge[dst]; ~i != 0; i = prev_edge[graph[i^1].dest])
                bottleneck = Math.min(bottleneck, graph[i].capacity - graph[i].flow);
            for (int i = prev_edge[dst]; ~i != 0; i = prev_edge[graph[i^1].dest]) {
                graph[i].flow += bottleneck;
                graph[i^1].flow -= bottleneck;
                total_cost[0] += graph[i].weight * bottleneck;
            }
            total_flow += bottleneck;
        }
        return total_flow;
    }
    
    static int encode(int row, int col) { 
        return (row-1)*50 + col; 
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        int source = 101*55, sink = source + 1;
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        m = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        k = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[2]);
        c = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[3]);
        d = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[4]);
        
        reset(sink + 1);
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            int val = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
            connect(source, val, 1, 0);
        }
        
        for (int col = 1; col <= 50; col++) {
            for (int row = 1; row <= 103; row++) {
                int a = encode(row, col), b = encode(row+1, col);
                connect(a, b, INF, c);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 102; i++) {
            int node = i*50 + 1;
            connect(node, sink, INF, 0);
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            String[] line = br.readLine().split(" ");
            int u = Integer.parseInt(line[0]);
            int v = Integer.parseInt(line[1]);
            for (int row = 1; row <= 102; row++) {
                int a = encode(row, u), a_next = encode(row+1, u);
                int b_next = encode(row+1, v), b = encode(row, v);
                for (int layer = 0; layer < 50; layer++) {
                    int cost = d*(layer*2+1) + c;
                    connect(a, b_next, 1, cost);
                    connect(b, a_next, 1, cost);
                }
            }
        }
        
        int[] total_cost = new int[1];
        compute_min_cost_flow(source, sink, total_cost);
        System.out.println(total_cost[0]);
    }
}
